Shannon entropies of SAR and PolSAR models

Source: R/entropy.R
entropy.Rd

Closed-form Shannon entropies \(H = E\{-\log f(Z)\}\) for the models used in SAR (intensity) and PolSAR (matrix) image analysis. All functions are vectorised in the scalar parameters.

Usage

entropy_gamma(mu, L)

entropy_g0i(alpha, gamma, L)

entropy_ggamma(alpha, phi, mu)

entropy_wishart(Sigma, L)

entropy_g0p(alpha, Sigma, L)

Arguments

mu

Mean of the Gamma law, or inverse scale of the generalized Gamma law.

L

Number of looks.

alpha

Roughness (G0I, G0 polarimetric) or power (generalized Gamma) parameter.

gamma

Scale parameter of the G0I law.

phi

Shape parameter of the generalized Gamma law.

Sigma

Hermitian positive definite covariance matrix.

Value

Numeric vector of entropies.

Details

Gamma

\(H = L - \log L + \log\mu + \log\Gamma(L) + (1 - L)\psi^{(0)}(L)\).

G0I

(Ferreira and Nascimento, 2020) \(H = -\log\frac{L^L\Gamma(L-\alpha)}{\Gamma(-\alpha)\gamma^\alpha \Gamma(L)} + (1 - L)[\psi^{(0)}(L) - \log L + \log\gamma - \psi^{(0)}(-\alpha)] + (L - \alpha)[\psi^{(0)}(L - \alpha) + \log\gamma - \psi^{(0)}(-\alpha)]\).

Generalized Gamma

\(H = -\log\alpha + \log\Gamma(\phi) + \phi - (\phi - 1/\alpha)\psi^{(0)}(\phi) - \log\mu\).

Scaled complex Wishart

(Nascimento, Ferreira and Frery, 2023) \(H = m\log|\Sigma| - m^2\log L + \log\Gamma_m(L) + mL + (m - L)\psi^{(0)}_m(L)\), with \(\psi^{(0)}_m(L) = \sum_{i=0}^{m-1}\psi^{(0)}(L - i)\).

G0 polarimetric

(Nascimento, Ferreira and Frery, 2023) obtained from \(E\log|Z| = m[\log(-\alpha-1) - \psi^{(0)}(-\alpha)] + \log|\Sigma| - m\log L + \psi^{(0)}_m(L)\) and \(E\log[L\,\mathrm{tr}(\Sigma^{-1}Z) - \alpha - 1] = \log(-\alpha-1) + \psi^{(0)}(mL - \alpha) - \psi^{(0)}(-\alpha)\).

References

Ferreira, J. A. and Nascimento, A. D. C. (2020). Shannon entropy for the G0I model: a new segmentation approach. IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing, 13, 2547–2553. doi:10.1109/JSTARS.2020.2997666

Nascimento, A. D. C., Ferreira, J. A. and Frery, A. C. (2023). Unsupervised segmentation of PolSAR data with complex Wishart and G0m distributions and Shannon entropy. Statistics and Computing, 33, 129. doi:10.1007/s11222-023-10298-0

Examples

entropy_gamma(mu = 1, L = 4)
#> [1] 0.6371121
entropy_g0i(alpha = -3, gamma = 2, L = 4)
#> [1] 0.8625083
entropy_ggamma(alpha = 1, phi = 4, mu = 4) # equals the Gamma entropy
#> [1] 0.6371121
S <- polsar_example_sigma("forest")
entropy_wishart(S, L = 4)
#> [1] -12.04464
entropy_g0p(alpha = -5, Sigma = S, L = 4)
#> [1] -12.48772
